_comment: Twin-graph ruling answer keys (ADR 0077; ruling: AIVIA_Design/Twin_Graph_KG_RULING.md). Authored BEFORE any phase code — the tests-first entry obligation. Four families = the four ruled phases; every case: input (sql or scenario) + expected assertions the phase build's tests walk. Deciding examples reuse Sunny-ratified material from the ruling and Floor_Grammar v1.1-1.3; corpse cases cite their gap-check finding. Status until each phase builds: NOT-RUNNABLE by design.

phase_A_projection.title: ROW_NUMBER projection member captured (the FIRST_TIME_LINE / Gap B corpse)
phase_A_projection.sql: SELECT ENCOUNTER_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ENCOUNTER_ID ORDER BY SCORE_DTTM) AS FIRST_TIME_LINE INTO #ED_PositiveScores FROM SEPSIS_SCORES WHERE SCORE >= 4
expected: scope #ED_PositiveScores has a PROJECTION structure node
projection has exactly 2 member nodes, position-ordered
member 2 name == FIRST_TIME_LINE, expression subtree kind == window function
member 1 name == ENCOUNTER_ID, expression subtree kind == column_ref resolving to KG1
conservation equation unchanged: handled + counted == AST total

phase_A_projection.title: single-column SELECT DISTINCT ... INTO (the readmit block, finding 4's carrier)
phase_A_projection.sql: SELECT DISTINCT [#Base_Pop].ENCOUNTER_ID INTO #Base_Pop_ED_Readmit FROM #ED_PositiveScores INNER JOIN #Base_Pop ON [#ED_PositiveScores].ENCOUNTER_ID = [#Base_Pop].ENCOUNTER_ID WHERE [#ED_PositiveScores].FIRST_TIME_LINE = 1
expected: projection has exactly 1 member node (ENCOUNTER_ID)
INTO target is a write target, never a read (DESC-TEMP-1 law holds)
member's column_ref resolves to the #Base_Pop scope, not KG1

phase_A_projection.title: SELECT * is a counted branch until ruled (no silent expansion)
expected: star projection lands as a COUNTED remainder row with reason star_projection
no invented member nodes
conservation holds with the counted row

phase_B_translator.title: the conservation equation, generalized
expected: every KG2a node has exactly one KG2b node: translated + gap == parsed total, no third bucket
every meaning node points_at exactly one KG2a node

every meaning node carries kind from the closed meaning-kind library (nine + the two COMPOSITE kinds file/statement - Phase B build correction 2026-09-06: the draft library missed the composite grains the homomorphism law reaches), content_key, translator+metamodel stamps
composite nodes (scope, statement, file) have content composed from children's meanings

phase_B_translator.title: syntax-only churn keeps the key
phase_B_translator.scenario: same predicate three ways: (a) reformatted whitespace, (b) alias renamed E->ENC, (c) AND arms reordered
expected: all three variants yield IDENTICAL content_keys for every meaning node
trailing comment changes never change a key

phase_B_translator.title: a truth change changes the key (the 24->48 readmit window)
expected: changing 24 to 48 changes the RANGE condition node's content_key
changing BETWEEN bounds' columns changes the key
changing INNER to LEFT on the carrying join changes the source node's key

phase_B_translator.title: 1=1 is translated, subkinded, never lost
expected: 1=1 yields a condition node with subkind degenerate
it is present in the twin (homomorphism holds), flagged voiced=never
the LIKE predicate translates normally beside it

phase_B_translator.title: derived meaning cites its sources
expected: the condition node's draws_from cites the KG1 column (dictionary words) AND its values map entry (2 -> 'Completed')
a column with no dictionary entry yields readable-name content + a counted coverage gap, never silence

phase_C_voicing.title: the finding-4 corpse voices (composition over source nodes)
phase_C_voicing.scenario: voice scope #Base_Pop_ED_Readmit from the sepsis corpus
expected: composition sentence names all three sources: the positive-scores selection, the base-population selection, the ED encounter read
INNER joins voice as restriction; the 24-hour RANGE voices as the match window
no raw identifier reaches prose (R5 law, now covering RANGE bounds - the line-83 side-find)

phase_C_voicing.title: voiced union counted == total, disjoint
phase_C_voicing.scenario: any voiced surface over any translated scope
expected: every meaning node in the surface's scope is voiced or counted, never absent from both
each omission traces to a policy line or a gap-census row
degenerate nodes counted under policy-silence, never voiced

phase_C_voicing.title: findings 1-3 stay dead (byte-exact once floors regenerate)
expected: finding 1 (R8): trailing comments voice WITH attribution, never bare fact
finding 2 (v1.1.0): the ADT two-alias scope voices BOTH event-subtype filters, instance-marked
finding 3 (v1.3.0): INNER-ON filters voice as membership; OUTER-ON residues counted, never voiced as filters

phase_C_voicing.title: anonymous derived tables inline at depth 1; deeper counts
phase_C_voicing.sql: FROM A INNER JOIN (SELECT ENCOUNTER_ID FROM B INNER JOIN (SELECT PATIENT_ID FROM C WHERE X = 1) c2 ON c2.PATIENT_ID = B.PATIENT_ID) b2 ON b2.ENCOUNTER_ID = A.ENCOUNTER_ID
expected: depth-1 anonymous scope (b2) renders inline in the composition sentence
depth-2 scope (c2) lands in gap-census with the revisit trigger declared
translation of c2 is still TOTAL - the cap is on prose only

phase_D_anchors.title: certification survives syntax-only churn
phase_D_anchors.scenario: certify a scope description; reformat the file + rename an alias; re-run the pipeline
expected: content_keys unchanged -> the certification survives silently, zero steward touches
no new artifact version is created

phase_D_anchors.title: a meaning change visibly orphans (24->48)
phase_D_anchors.scenario: certify the readmit description; change the window to 48 hours; re-run
expected: the anchor's content_key mismatches -> the artifact flags as orphaned (a drift FINDING)
the artifact is never deleted and never silently re-attached

phase_D_anchors.title: S2 corollary: deletion orphans with candidates
phase_D_anchors.scenario: certify a scope; delete the scope from the file; re-run
expected: artifact orphaned with similarity candidates from relatedness
re-attachment stays a human act

phase_D_anchors.title: the anchor migration itself (Phase D entry)
phase_D_anchors.scenario: migrate existing KG3 artifacts from file::scope-name anchors to content_key anchors
expected: every migrated artifact resolves to exactly one meaning identity or lands as a counted migration orphan (a FINDING, not an error)
migrated + orphaned == pre-migration artifact count
